text: No. It's safe in the sense that it won't break or harm the dishwasher, but the detergent and prolonged water exposure strip the seasoning (the polymerized oil layer) and the pan will likely rust, sometimes within hours of the cycle ending. Wash it by hand with hot water and a brush, dry it immediately, and wipe on a thin coat of oil. If it does go through, it's recoverable: scrub off any rust and re-season it.
